plain_english_policy: support a constitutional amendment for community control of local school funding and standards

effects.rationale: local communities have more direct influence over education which can lead to better tailored educational policies and outcomes.
A constitutional amendment may require intervention in the market by altering existing governance structures, potentially leading to a shift from market-driven decisions to more community-led ones.

evidence_quote: "Support a constitutional amendment giving communities control over local school funding and standards." - Question on educational issues for Alabama candidate questionnaire in 2002.
